workflow_definition: A deterministic repository-maintenance transformation from a pinned parent commit to a pinned target change, followed by that repository's declared pinned pytest tests. Every repeat starts from a fresh copy of the same parent snapshot. The scripts test filesystem-policy behavior; they do not test patch discovery or model coding ability.
grouping: 11 workflows across seven repository groups: click (W01-W02), packaging (W03-W04), python-dotenv (W05-W06), attrs (W07), filelock (W08), iniconfig (W09 and W11), pluggy (W10). They are not 11 independent repositories.
deferred_representation: The selected repositories expose no pinned, dependency-light project-native source-code generator with a stable command across the suite. W04 uses Python compileall as deterministic generated-artifact coverage; it is bytecode compilation, not source-code generation. W02 builds a deterministic source archive with the standard library, not the repository's official release backend. These limits will be stated in the report.
